_readme: Copy this file to press-room.config.json and edit it. Every key is optional — an empty {}
boots something that works offline (the redaction gate, the checkers, the renderers on hand-made
input). Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored by the loader.
Anything that reaches OUT of the repo — your transcripts, the live site, credentials, the send
command — defaults to empty/off, and the code degrades honestly rather than crashing.
Full setup in README.md; the security posture in docs/SECURITY.md.
_senderName: Display name on the daily digest email.
_senderAddress: From: address on the daily digest.
_replyAddress: From:/Reply-To: on reply-lane answers. The lane sends ONLY as this address.
_ownerAddresses: Your own addresses. HOLD/RESUME control mail is only honored from these.
_ignoreFrom: Service/plumbing senders that are never treated as a subscriber question.
_siteUrl: Your site root. Archive links point here and it is half of the reply-lane link allowlist.
_newsletterUrl: Where the daily footer sends people for your own longer writing.
_githubUser: GitHub user/org whose repo permalinks a reply may cite. Empty => repo citations are refused.
_subscribeEndpoint: POST endpoint for the archive signup box. Empty => the signup box is omitted from rendered pages.
_model: The brain for every contained model stage. Pin an explicit id, never an alias.
_transcriptsDir: The Claude Code transcript directory the digest harvests. Claude keys these by the session's
working directory, so a session run from a different folder lands in a different dir — see
docs/OPERATING.md. Empty => the transcript source is skipped (git + session-log sources still run).
_siteProductionDir: Where rendered archive/fixes pages are written for you to review/deploy. Empty => only ./out/ is written.
_publicReposDir: Directory holding local clones of your public repos, used to verify a cited link is real.
_fixesPage: The public 'what changed' page build-fixes-day writes onto. Empty => derived from siteProductionDir/fixes.html, else the fixes step is skipped.
_worldRoot: The folder that contains your source repos. Relative resolves against the repo root; default is the repo's parent.
_sourceRepos: Repos scanned for the day's git activity in the digest. path is relative to worldRoot unless absolute.
_productRepos: Subset of sourceRepos whose USER-VISIBLE changes feed the public fixes page.
_sources: Optional extra evidence the digest harvests. Each empty => that source is skipped.
_publicRepos: Public repos admitted into the reply composer's reading room. dest is where it lands; path is under publicReposDir.
_dataFolders: Internal working folders. Defaults work out of the box; change only if you must.
_credentials: PATHS ONLY — never the values. You supply the files, outside the repo. Empty => that step reports missing-credential cleanly.
_mailAccountId: Your JMAP account id (reply-lane intake and the HOLD-email brake).
_mailGroups: The subscriber-list group names that make a sender count as a subscriber.
_claudeBin: Path to the claude binary the jail runs.
_crashLog: Where a dead contained spawn is recorded.
_commandHooks: Steps that live OUTSIDE the shop shape — dispatching the daily email, the off-box heartbeat, the
phone ping. These are the machinery this repo deliberately does not ship. Give a shell command
and the orchestrator will run it; leave empty and the step is skipped and logged, never faked.
_timezone: The shop's clock. All UTC->local normalization uses this one zone.
